instruction:
Create Polygroups from UV Tiles (UDIMs)

The file at C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.obj contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named UVQuadPlane, is a flat 4x4 subdivided plane in the XY plane centred at origin (side length 2 BU, 16 quad faces, 25 vertices). The plane's UVs are already laid out across four UDIM tiles: the four 2x2 face-quadrants of the plane each map bijectively to a distinct UDIM. Top-left is tile 1001, top-right is 1002, bottom-left is 1003, and bottom-right is 1004. All 16 faces currently share a single default polygroup. The mesh has no polypaint and no subdivision-level stack.

Load this OBJ into ZBrush with UVs preserved, convert the UV-tile assignments into polygroups, and export the result as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.obj with both polygroups and UVs preserved.

The exported C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.obj must satisfy:

- Exactly one SubTool, still named UVQuadPlane, with its base geometry unchanged.
- Every face has UV indices written out in the OBJ.
- The number of distinct polygroup IDs on the mesh is exactly 4.
- Each face's UV centroid falls inside exactly one UDIM tile from {1001, 1002, 1003, 1004}, and all four tiles are represented.
- Each polygroup's faces all share the same UDIM tile.
- The four polygroups collectively use four distinct tiles.
